comment: CCSDS TM transfer frame primary header: version, spacecraft and virtual channel ids, the operational control field flag, the master and virtual channel frame counts, and the data field status (secondary header, synchronization and packet order flags, segment length id, the first header pointer: where in the data field the first packet starts, in octets; 2047 none starts here, 2046 idle data only). Framed: the frame's length is the profile's (the RS data of its codewords); the data field runs to the frame's end less the operational control field (4 octets when its flag is set), which is passed over. No frame error control field (the RS code checks the frame)
